LESSON: OUR HOME

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade one
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Social Environment
Topic 1.2: Our Home
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 12

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Our Home, part of Social Environment in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade one ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How can you make your home environment clean and safe?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Our Home together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
Responsibility: learner enhances self-drive when keeping the home environment clean such as practicing cleaning assorted home items using

suitable cleaning materials.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Disaster risk reduction: learner develops awareness of potentially risk areas and objects that can cause harm/accidents to foster safety of self

and others.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Materials used for cleaning are used in Creative Activities to clean self after finger painting activities

5

Suggested Learning Resources

Approved support learning materials(textbooks), digital devices with assistive technology, table, chair, pictures of furniture, charts showing

different furniture, sisal fibre, water, soap, piece of cloth.
